name: Telekinesis
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of engaging with familiar spirits, wizards, and sorcery, warning believers to avoid such defilement as seen in Leviticus and Deuteronomy. The account of Simon in Acts illustrates the deceptive nature of sorcery, which stands in opposition to God’s truth. Jesus teaches that genuine spiritual authority and power come through faith in Him, not through occult or supernatural manipulation, emphasizing that with faith even mountains can move, highlighting the contrast between divine power and forbidden practices like telekinesis.
